title: The Cozy Cleveland
description:
Enjoy a warm and stylish experience at this centrally-located home located only minutes from downtown. This is a brand new, one bedroom unit that offers a pull out sofa, sleeping a maximum of 4. Ideally, the space is suited for 2-3 adults, with a full kitchen and modern bathroom.  Free driveway parking, a lovely outdoor sitting area and designer finishes make this a perfect choice!

The space
This is a brand new, one bedroom unit that sits above a 2 car garage. Spacious and pristine with designer finishes, the unit is accessed by a wide set of steps to the upstairs unit.

Guest access
Guests are welcome to park one vehicle in the driveway, marked space. Access the unit with a digital lock. Washer and dryer are available for your use at the entrance of the unit.

Other things to note
This is an upstairs unit that sits above a garage. There are steps convenient to the upstairs home. New construction with designer finishes, this rental is convenient to 'all things Nashville'!
